items.text: Change the stage from Adopted to In force
items.reason: The revised ESRS entered into force on 10 November 2026.

items.text: New status text: “Entered into force on 10 November 2026 and apply from financial year 2027; the voluntary standard has been in force since 24 September 2026.”
items.reason: Reflects that the 10 November 2026 entry into force date has passed.

items.text: Add the date 2026-11-12: “EU ETS provisional agreement reached on free carbon allowances revision”
items.reason: On 12 November 2026, the Council and European Parliament reached a provisional agreement to boost free carbon allowances for energy-intensive industries.

items.text: Add the date 2026-11-19: “SFDR 2.0 provisional agreement reached between Council and Parliament”
items.reason: On 19 November 2026, the Council and European Parliament reached a provisional political agreement on the SFDR 2.0 reform.

items.text: New status text: “Trilogue negotiations concluded with a provisional agreement reached between the Council and European Parliament on 19 November 2026.”
items.reason: The Council and Parliament struck a deal on SFDR 2.0 rules, bringing trilogue negotiations to a successful conclusion.

items.text: Add the date 2026-11-04: “Green Claims Commission officially confirms withdrawal of the proposal”
items.reason: The European Commission officially confirmed the withdrawal and scrapping of the Green Claims Directive proposal in November 2026.

items.text: New status text: “Officially withdrawn by the European Commission in November 2026 following the earlier suspension of trilogue negotiations.”
items.reason: The Commission officially confirmed the withdrawal of the Green Claims Directive proposal.
